name: assistant-cabinet-coder
description: Gives the VS Code chat the models of an Assistant Cabinet server.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In a workspace that is not trusted, VS Code disables the chat and the models of extensions. The Assistant Cabinet Coder commands stay available.

scripts.spike:package: npm run spike:build && cd spike && vsce package --no-dependencies --skip-license --allow-missing-repository

assistantCabinetCoder.serverUrl.markdownDescription: Address of the Assistant Cabinet server: the scheme (http or https), the host name or IP address and, if needed, the port. Leave empty to use the server installed on this computer (see `#assistantCabinetCoder.autoDiscover#`).

assistantCabinetCoder.caFile.markdownDescription: Path of the public authority file (`ca.pem`) that signed the server certificate. Empty: for a server installed on this computer, its own `ca.pem`; otherwise the authorities your system already trusts. Use the command Select CA File.

assistantCabinetCoder.autoDiscover.markdownDescription: When no server address is set, read the settings file of a server installed on this computer (`server.env`, which holds no secret) to find its address.

assistantCabinetCoder.requestTimeoutSeco.markdownDescription: How many seconds to wait with no byte received before a request is abandoned. A long prompt delays the first byte, so the default is generous.
